summary: Frontend E2E tested the three NEW PMS Bağlantı Merkezi features (Pilot Hunisi Özeti, Takip Hatırlatıcısı, Aylık Tatbikat Robotu arşiv UI) plus regressions. Funnel + drill-history + PDF archive all work; per-lead stale badge (pms-lead-stale-{id}) is NOT rendered in the frontend even though backend returns stale=true for Otel A (10 days).

ui_bugs.issue: Per-lead stale badge with data-testid='pms-lead-stale-{id}' is missing. Backend response includes stale:true and days_in_stage:10 for 'Otel A' but the row markup (~line 601-611) only shows hotel_name, date, status select, and note input. Header badge pms-leads-stale-badge exists and is correct ('⏰ 1 otel 7+ gündür bekliyor') but the per-row ⏰ Xg bekliyor badge required by the spec is absent.

action_items: Render per-lead stale badge in PmsConnectHub.js lead row. Example: inside the row header span, add {l.stale && ⏰ {l.days_in_stage}g bekliyor}. Backend already sends l.stale and l.days_in_stage.
critical_code_review_comments: PmsConnectHub.js is 864 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline threshold; consider splitting sub-sections (leads/drill/rate-mapping) into child components in a future refactor.
runDrill fetches history after every click but never handles error separately — history stays stale if history GET fails silently after successful drill.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (4 of 5 sub-checks pass; per-lead stale badge missing)

seed_data_creation: None. Existing seeded pilot leads (Otel A backdated 10 days -> stale, Otel B görüşme, Otel C demo, Otel D pilot) and 5 drill records incl. one robot+archived were present and verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Navigation: /login → email/password submit → do NOT wait for /dashboard URL (login lands on root '/'), just wait 4s → click [data-testid='command-palette-trigger'] → type 'PMS Bağlantı' → Enter. Leads section requires clicking [data-testid='pms-leads-btn'] first. Drill section covers leads once opened, so test leads-add BEFORE running drill. PDF endpoints: /api/pms-connect/killswitch-drill/archive/{id}/pdf and /api/pms-connect/killswitch-drill/{pid}/report-pdf both return 200 application/pdf (~2829 bytes). Backend field names for leads: leads[].stale (bool), leads[].days_in_stage (int). Funnel field: funnel[].reached (cumulative count), funnel[].conv_pct (null for first stage), funnel[].avg_days_in_stage.
verified_working: Funnel chips pms-funnel-{davet|görüşme|demo|pilot} render with correct data: davet 4 ~10g, görüşme 3 %75 ~0g, demo 2 %67 ~0g, pilot 1 %50 ~0g
Header stale badge pms-leads-stale-badge shows '⏰ 1 otel 7+ gündür bekliyor'
pms-drill-history block appears with 5 rows including one '🤖 otomatik · 📦 PDF arşivde' row
Every pms-drill-hist-pdf-{id} link returns HTTP 200 application/pdf
Note in history: 'Aylık otomatik tatbikat robotu AKTİF — her ayın 1'inde çalışır, PDF'i arşivler' present
rca of the issue: Frontend PmsConnectHub.js lead row (lines 600-611) never reads l.stale/l.days_in_stage from the API payload. Backend contract is correct and header aggregate badge is rendered from leads.stale_count, but the per-row per-lead visual indicator was omitted from the JSX. Simple additive fix — no state/API changes needed.
